description: Smoke task for system_settings_env: pre_task launches System Settings and waits for its window to register with LaunchServices. The verifier passes when the System Settings process is running with a registered window. No agent action required — this exists to validate the env end-to-end (preferences seeded, app launches with the right baseline) and to give a known-good interactive view via `gym-anything run … -i --open-vnc`.
natural_language: Wait. System Settings is launched before the agent gets control; no action is required.
